question: Given the determinant $\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} a & bc & 1 \\ b & ca & 1 \\ c & ab & 1 \end{vmatrix}$, evaluate $\Delta$ when $a=1, b=2, c=3$.
explanation:
Substitute $a=1, b=2, c=3$:

$\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & (2)(3) & 1 \\ 2 & (3)(1) & 1 \\ 3 & (1)(2) & 1 \end{vmatrix}$

$= \begin{vmatrix} 1 & 6 & 1 \\ 2 & 3 & 1 \\ 3 & 2 & 1 \end{vmatrix}$

Expand along third column:

$= 1 \begin{vmatrix}2 & 3 \\ 3 & 2 \end{vmatrix} - 1 \begin{vmatrix}1 & 6 \\ 3 & 2 \end{vmatrix} + 1 \begin{vmatrix}1 & 6 \\ 2 & 3 \end{vmatrix}$

$= 1(2 \times 2 - 3 \times 3) - 1(1 \times 2 - 3 \times 6) + 1(1 \times 3 - 2 \times 6)$

$= 1(4 - 9) - 1(2 - 18) + 1(3-12)$

$= 1(-5) - 1(-16) + 1(-9)$

$= -5 + 16 - 9 = 2$.
